coded.code: {CellValue:-_} = system.LookupDataTable(dataTable: {DataTable}, lookupValue: {LookupValue}, lookupColumnName: {LookupColumnName}, targetColumnName: {TargetColumnName}, rowIndex: out {RowIndex:-_});

{CellValue:-_} = system.LookupDataTable(dataTable: {DataTable}, lookupValue: {LookupValue}, lookupColumnName: {DataTable}.Columns[{LookupColumnIndex}].ColumnName, targetColumnName: {DataTable}.Columns[{TargetColumnIndex}].ColumnName, rowIndex: out {RowIndex:-_});

{CellValue:-_} = system.LookupDataTable(dataTable: {DataTable}, lookupValue: {LookupValue}, lookupColumnName: {LookupDataColumn}.ColumnName, targetColumnName: {TargetDataColumn}.ColumnName, rowIndex: out {RowIndex:-_});

notes: ISystemService.LookupDataTable(dataTable, lookupValue, lookupColumnName, targetColumnName, out rowIndex)。列名で渡す API なので、列番号・DataColumn は列名にして渡す。out の rowIndex は code で書く（捨てるときは out _）
